LOVE TO THE MOON AND KEY 
#MoonshadowSeriesFinalEP #fonkanittha

🦁: EmiBonnie, is there anything you want to tell P'Fon?
🦊: I really have to thank P'Fon, bc we know how much effort she put into this, even before we know we'd be starring in this series. She put a lot of thought into what kind of series she wanted us to do. She's very dedicated and meticulous with every project she works on. Thank you, bc I know how tired she's been. She's really working on so many things. It's really exhausting.
🐰: (brings P'Fon's hand over so that she and Emi can hold hands)
🦊: Thank you so much.
🦁: What abt you, P'Bon?
🐰: P'Fon has been with me since the very start of my journey.
🐰: 🥺
🌧️: Don't cry, otherwise you might not look beautiful!
🐰: (looks at Emi) 
🦊: 🥺
🐰: P'Mi's already gone!
🐰: If it weren't for P'Fon, then there wouldn't be EmiBonnie. Let me tell you.
🦊: Really.
🌧️: You're getting all emotional.
🐰: No, really.
🦊: Really. P'Fon was the one who chose us two.
🐰: P'Fon was the one who chose me to go try casting with P'Mi back when I didn't have anything at all yet. She brought me into 'High School (Frenemy)' and gave me the chance to cast with and meet P'Mi. It's really thanks to P'Fon that EmiBonnie exists today.
🌧️: And was it good? When I picked you to be with P'Mi, was it good?
🐰: It's good.
🌧️: 😆
🐰: If it weren't for P'Fon, then there wouldn't be EmiBonnie today.
🌧️: No, if two ppl are meant to be, then they're meant to be! They're meant to be together 😆
🦊: I heard that P'Fon was the one who decided that it had to be us two.
🌧️: Yeah.
🦁: It's not only heaven-sent, but rain-sent 😆
🌧️: I casted you two twice.
🦊: Thank you for seeing something in us, even back when we couldn't see anything in ourselves.
🐰: Yeah.
🦁: And what did you see in them?
🐰: She felt for us* 😆
🦊: She felt for us 😆
🦊: Actually, P'Fon has a really good eye.
🐰: Yeah.
🦊: Bonnie really is the best of the best.
🐰: 😌
🗣️: 🐒🐒🐒🐒🐒🐒
🌧️: The best of the best! What the heck!
🦁: They love each other, P'Fon!
🦊: Really, really. She's very charming, just as you said since the very first day, P'Fon.
🌧️: (can't take it and stands up)
🦁: You're complimenting her again! You just keep complimenting her!
🐰: "I was just minding my own business~"**
🌧️: (can't take it and stands up again)
🦊: Isn't it true?
🌧️: They're meant to be together 😆

* Play on the word เห็น (hen), which means "see". While it means "see" on its own, when combined with ใจ (jai), which means "heart", to form เห็นใจ (hen jai), it means "to feel empathetic for someone)".

** From the song "เพราะพี่รักจริง (Because I Truly Love You)" by Neung BK Band. The lyrics go "I was just minding my own business, you're the one who approached me. I was just sitting there minding my own business, you're the one who fell in love with me".

note_tweet.text:
Pride has destroyed many marriages, sometimes in ways that cheating never could.

Two people can love each other deeply and still watch their marriage fall apart because neither one is willing to admit they're wrong.

A husband knows he hurt his wife, but his ego won't let him apologize. A wife knows she's gone too far, but she'd rather stay angry than be the first to make peace.

Days become weeks. Conversations stop. Small problems become big wounds, and both people sit in the same house waiting for the other to make the first move.

Sometimes all it would take is one honest apology and a little humility to begin repairing the damage.

Never let your pride become more important than the person you promised to love.
